description.narrative: The Fund is expected to increase access to mezzanine financing, private equity (PE) capital and value-creation for SMEs in LAC, supporting them to scale while delivering sustainability outcomes. Private equity remains extremely scarce in frontier regions of LAC such as Ecuador, Peru and Costa Rica. The Fund will provide equity financing and create value to portfolio companies through E&S capacity building, business advisory for financial management and corporate governance, and carbon footprint assessments across all investees. A meaningful share will also be invested in women owned or led businesses. Beyond the project, successful raising this fund at a larger size builds their track record to upsize across successive funds and demonstrates the model that can work at sufficient scale to be attractive to institutional investors. It also signals market opportunities for PE to expand in the LAC region beyond generalist funds targeting larger markets.

The proposal is for a potential equity investment into EcoEnterprises IV (Fund IV, or the Fund) of up to US$10 million, capped at 20% of total commitments. EcoEnterprises IV is an impact fund focused on investing in small and medium companies in LAC, with a focus on the following regions: Central America, Mexico, the Caribbean, Andean and Brazil. EcoEnterprises (the Fund Manager) will seek to build a portfolio of 15-20 investments, across mezzanine, quasi-equity, and equity instruments. Ticket sizes will range from US$3 million to US$10 million. Fund IV will be a continuation of the predecessor funds strategy and focus on three main investment themes: (i) sustainable products, (ii) ag-tech, (iii) climate-tech, (iv) circular economy, and (v) clean energy.
